verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in dev UI explicitly for testing, evaluating, and debugging agents, which implies some run-level visibility into agent execution, but the evidence never confirms a dedicated trace view of every individual LLM call and tool invocation (e.g. spans, timelines, or OpenTelemetry/Cloud Trace integration). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-call/per-tool tracing granularity, screenshots or docs of a trace/timeline view, and any third-party observability integration confirmation.
